Checklist:

* [ ] Either
    * I've created a [Feature Request](https://github.com/cyclops-k8s/ansible-kubernetes/issues/new/choose) and discussed it with the community.
    * This is a bug fix.
    * This does not need to be in the release notes.
* [ ] The title of the PR states what changed.
* [ ] Either
    * Include "Closes [ISSUE #]", "Fixes [ISSUE #]" or "Resolves [ISSUE #]" in the description to automatically close the associated issue.
    * Reference an [ISSUE #] with a reason as to why it does not complete an issue
* [ ] If required, I've updated the documentation, or I plan to submit a second PR with documentation updates.
* [ ] I have added a brief description of why this PR is necessary and/or what this PR solves if the issue/title is not descriptive enough.
